advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Namespace the event index by store (key on (store, ticket_id, uuid)) so a cross-store (ticket_id,uuid) collision cannot cause sidecar_data_for_row to look up a blob sha absent from the row's own store.
evidence: tier0.py:171 `index[(blob.ticket_id, blob.uuid)] = blob` — keyed only by (ticket_id, uuid), not by store

tier0.py:150-153 `tracker_path = tracker_paths.get(row['store'])` then `corpus._batch_cat(tracker_path, [blob.sha])` — cats blob.sha from the ROW's store, which may differ from the store the winning blob came from
tier0.py:154-156 a missing body returns None → run_tier0 increments `skipped` silently (tier0.py:365-367)
advisory.finding: build_event_index dedupes REVIEW_RESULT blobs across ALL stores by (ticket_id, uuid) into one flat index, but sidecar_data_for_row then re-reads the blob from tracker_paths.get(row['store']). If two stores share a (ticket_id, uuid) key, the index keeps the last store's blob sha, which does not exist in the other store's git object DB; _batch_cat returns nothing and the row is silently counted as skipped rather than replayed.
scenarios: run_tier0 invoked with multiple --store entries where the same ticket_id/review_event_uuid appears in more than one store
advisory.suggested_fix: Key build_event_index per store — e.g. return {store_name: {(ticket_id, uuid): blob}} and have sidecar_data_for_row select the row['store'] submap — so the blob sha always belongs to the store it is cat'd from.

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test driving candidate_decisions with execution_review=True and an on-target-veto finding, asserting the cohort restriction is applied.
evidence: tier0.py:125-126: `if execution_review:` / `verifs = orchestrator._restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded(findings, verifs)`
search for `execution_review=True` in the test file hits only replayed_stored_decision and mirrored_threshold_for calls — never candidate_decisions
search for `_restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded` in the test file: (no matches)

Named violating input: a finding whose criteria include an on-target-veto criterion, with a non-grounded verification, replayed via candidate_decisions(..., execution_review=True) — the restriction must change the verifs cohort but no test asserts it does.
blocking.finding: candidate_decisions's execution_review=True branch — which calls orchestrator._restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded and is described in the commit as a core fidelity mirror of the plan-review wrapper — is never exercised. Every candidate_decisions/flip test passes execution_review=False, so a regression that dropped or wrongly applied the on-target-veto cohort restriction in the candidate path would not be caught.
scenarios: A refactor or bug that skips the veto restriction (or applies it to the wrong cohort) in the candidate execution-review path ships green.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Make the self-check assert the producer ran (e.g. surface/require total_findings>0) so self_check_mismatches==0 cannot be reported for a corpus where nothing was replayed.
evidence: tier0.py:259-266 returns `self_check_mismatches: 0` and `total_findings: 0` when replayed_rows is empty (see test_flip_matrix_empty_rows)
tier0.py:257 `friction_rate = ... if total_findings else 0.0` — the all-skipped case yields the same 'clean' matrix as a real all-pass run
The self-check is intended as a liveness guarantee ('this MUST always equal stored') but a zero-finding corpus produces the pass verdict without the check ever running against a finding
dropped.finding: flip_matrix's self-check verdict self_check_mismatches==0 is indistinguishable from a run where every row was skipped: when total_findings==0 the matrix reports 0 mismatches and 0 flips, the same values a genuinely clean replay produces. Nothing in flip_matrix or run_tier0 asserts that any findings were actually scored.
scenarios: run_tier0 over a corpus whose rows are all skipped (all v1 sidecars, or all unmatched in the event index) — the report shows self_check_mismatches: 0 as if verified
dropped.suggested_fix: Have report.render_report / run_tier0 treat total_findings==0 (or row_count==0) as an explicit 'no findings replayed — self-check did not run' state distinct from a clean pass.
